No spelling mistake in the text or the identifiers.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Command | `typos` |
| Confronts | `code` `test` `spec` |
| Blocking by default — new project | no — informs |

## Declaring it

```yaml
gates:
  - name: spellcheck
    on: [code, test, spec]
    run: "typos"
```
